Pri (CSM): Heads-up: RelayHealth spotted a sudden 81% drop in active API keys after yesterday's invoice landed. Renewal in 10 days. tagging for triage — customer is upset about a surprise billing line item.

metrics-bot: Auto-alert RelayHealth: active_keys: 420 -> 80 (-81%), billing.events: invoice.generated (1), invoice_amount: $48,720 -> $103,200 (unexpected line: 'excess-qps surcharge'). dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/relayhealth/health

Carlos (AE): Procurement just pinged saying BeaconCloud offered a migration credit and waived onboarding fees. They're sensitive to costs right now. We should tread carefully and avoid promising credits without Finance.

Pri (CSM): Agree. First step: understand invoice details and whether surcharge is legit. @Jun can you surface the meter breakdown for last billing period?

Jun (Solutions Eng): On it. Quick query output attached (summary):
```
# meter-breakdown (last 30d)
requests: 12,420
qps-peaks: 110
metered-burst: 4200 tokens billed
surcharge-reason: sustained-burst-threshold-exceeded
```
I'll DM the raw CSV to Pri.

Meera (Customer Ops): New procurement contact is L. Ortiz as of last week. Their champion (Head of Infra) left. I'll intro Pri to Ortiz and set an urgent call.

Pri (CSM): Proposed immediate play: 1) offer a neutral invoice review and walk-through; 2) if surcharge was caused by a config change on our side, offer a one-time credit; 3) if caused by customer-side burst, show mitigation options (burst window, quota smoothing) and offer a transient quota tweak while they evaluate other vendors. Need Finance & Legal guidance before any credit language.

Dana (Finance): We can approve a one-time goodwill credit up to 25% of the disputed line pending review. Need a short writeup: cause, delta, and evidence. Do not commit publicly until we confirm.

Ivy (Legal): We can review outreach copy. Avoid wording like "we'll waive fees" or "migration credits". If customer requests contractual concessions (price change, refunds) escalate to Legal & Finance.

Carlos (AE): I'll hold competitive conversation with Ortiz but will not mention credits. Focus on product ROI and migration pain.

Pri (CSM): Action items:
- Jun: deliver meter CSV + root cause analysis within 2h
- Meera: schedule 30m invoice walkthrough with Ortiz today
- Dana: tentatively approve up to 25% goodwill credit pending Jun's evidence
- Ivy: quick review of outreach language before send
- Carlos: prepare procurement-friendly talking points vs BeaconCloud (no pricing)

Jun (Solutions Eng): Uploaded CSV to secure share and will post a short RCA in 90m. Early sign: several long-lived worker processes retried at high concurrency after a deploy spike. Might be customer load pattern, but we're investigating a billing bucket edge-case.

metrics-bot: Monitoring: will alert if active_keys doesn't recover above 60% baseline in 12h. :eyes:
